thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — latency spike detected in EU cluster for /v1/generate. 5xx rate rising, p50->p99 divergence. Pager rule triggered at 02:15 UTC
maya singh: seeing alerts in Datadog too, p95 tokens latency ~2.1s and some 503s
jordan ng: I'm currently on sunrise shift but can stay. Are we primary/secondary swap? I'm GMT+1
liam park: I'm in APAC and can shadow but can't be primary for EU
eve ops: I can take primary for the next 2h if we don't have a primary. @oncall-schedule-bot can you confirm my eligibility? :raised_hands:
oncall-schedule-bot: @eve ops you are eligible; your rotation shows available for a 2-hour emergency takeover. Please confirm in thread.
maya singh: note: customer impact seems limited to EU hosted tenants — ticketing shows increased errors for a few accounts. Marking "potential customer impact".
samir khan: jumping on A/B rollback plan if config changes are suspected. Any deploys in last 30m? 
maya singh: no deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot. Suspect autoscaler + kernel contention on the model workers. Logs show OOMs on worker-3
liam park: runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-latency — follow section 'worker-oom-kernel' and 'fallback-to-variant'.
maya singh: ok @eve ops want you to be primary. I'll stay as secondary/triage. Can you do the handoff so it's clean in incident channel?
eve ops: confirmed, taking primary. I'll open bridge and set status. Starting with quick mitigation: scale worker pool to +2 replicas, enable fallback variant routing.
maya singh: commands:
```
# scale replica set
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-worker-eu --replicas=8
# enable fallback in routing config
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --region eu --variant small-8bit
```
maya singh: applying scale now — will monitor
liam park: I'll shadow logs and trace errors. If p50 doesn't drop in 5 minutes we should start KV-cache purge per runbook
eve ops: bridge: https://meet.redwood/incident/1765432101-eu-latency — oncall handoff: primary = @eve ops, secondary = @maya singh, shadow = @liam park. Handoff note: I have access to scaling perms and fallback toggles.
maya singh: confirmed. I've documented customer accounts impacted in the incident doc and pinged CS to pre-emptively notify major customers.
incident-bot: Incident updated: severity -> SEV2, bridge active, owners set.
samir khan: seeing model-worker-eu pods restarting less now after scale. p95 dropping to 1.2s. Good sign.
eve ops: will keep primary for next 90 minutes then hand back to @maya singh unless we still see tail latency. If anyone needs me to extend I can.
jordan ng: appreciate the quick pickup. I'll log the handoff in rotation spreadsheet and mark the slot as "covered".
maya singh: closing loop: runbook link + brief mitigation recorded in incident doc. If errors return, escalate to oncall director + open rollback to previous serving profile.
eve ops: thanks team :thumbsup: — will post a short summary when I hand back.
